subject: E-Commerce
title: FBA: Fulfillment as a Weapon
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: FBA: Fulfillment as a Weapon.

hook.text: Fulfillment by Amazon handles storage, packing, and shipping for 60% of Amazon sellers. It's convenient—and a trap.

buildup.text: FBA gives sellers Prime badge, faster shipping, and better search rankings. Not using FBA means lower visibility.

discovery.text: FBA costs rose 30% between 2020 and 2024. Sellers are locked in because leaving FBA means losing Prime eligibility.

twist.text: Amazon uses FBA data to see which products sell best, then launches competing products.

climax.text: FBA is brilliant for customers & profitable for Amazon. For sellers, it's a dependency grows more expensive every year.

punchline.text: 60% of sellers locked in, costs up 30%. FBA is convenience becomes dependency.

quiz.question: Why do sellers struggle to leave FBA once they start using it?
options: Leaving FBA means losing Prime badge and search ranking benefits
